profile.headline: Embedded Software Developer | C | AUTOSAR | CAN
profile.summary:
Electronics engineer, experienced on embedded systems development for the automotive industry. I love coding, technology and big challenges. I'm always looking for learning something new everyday.

Skills: C/C++ programming, RTOS concepts, AUTOSAR knowledge, Linux/Bash scripting, Git/GitHub, CAN tools (CANoe, CANape, etc.), ARM Cortex M architecture, i2c, SPI, CAN protocols, PIC/STM/ATmel micros, embedded systems, JTAG/SWD debugging interfaces and troubleshooting

positions.title: Embedded Software Developer
positions.description:
Project: Electronic Brake Control Module (EBCM) for Ford gasoline and electric vehicles.

- Integration of reusable SWC into a project variant using Git/SourceTree/BitBucket.
- Implementation of new features for SWC (embedded C code). 
- Implementation of client requirements in SW.
- Unit testing implementation for low level drivers and SWC's.
- Integration of new SWC, CDD and BSW using Vector's DaVinci and Autosar Builder.

Tools and technical knowledge: winIDEA debugger, Git, SourceTree, BitBucket, JIRA, Visual Studio Code, DOORS, Beyond Compare, CANalyzer, CANoe, CANape, UDS, AUTOSAR, Infineon microcontroller, DaVinci Configurator, Autosar Builder.

positions.title: Embedded Software Developer
positions.description:
Project: Electronic Power Steering (EPS) for GM Electric Vehicles (assigned to US location).

- Perform of bench testing for diagnostics (UDS) and troubleshooting using Vector Tools (CANoe, CANalyzer, CANape).
- Maintenance and improvement of embedded C code for dual core micros (RH850).
- Troubleshoot and debug of issues with Lauterbach T32 debugger (JTAG).
- Good knowledge in AUTOSAR Diagnostics Stack (DEM, DCM, etc).
- Static code analysis and MISRA cleanup with ASTRee.
- Ownership, maintenance and improvement of a SWC.
- Describe Architecture Requirements from System Requirements using IBM DOORS.
- Continuous improvement on Software Development Process based on ASPICE (V-Model). 
- Develop and maintenance of Architecture Models using Enterprise Architect.
- Usage of IBM Rational tools for version controlling (ClearCase, ClearQuest, etc.).
- Participate in various steps of V-Model (reviews, implementation, etc.)
- Implementation of Architecture Requirements.
- Support in interviews as technical interviewer.
- Participate actively in SCRUM ceremonies.

Tools and technical knowledge: JIRA, Atlassian tools, Lauterbach T32, Enterprise Architect, IBM DOORS, IBM ClearCase, IBM ClearQuest, ASTRee, Eclipse, CANoe, CANape, CANalyzer, INCA, DaVinci, EB Tresos, dSpace SystemDesk.

positions.title: Embedded Software Developer Jr
positions.description:
Project: Electronic Power Steering (EPS) for GM Electric Vehicles.

- Perform bench testing for diagnostics (UDS) and troubleshooting using Vector Tools (CANoe, CANalyzer, CANape).
- Usage of DOORS for system and software requirements analysis and test implementation.
- Diagnostics using UDS protocol
- Maintenance and calibration of embedded C software.
- Static code analysis.
- Usage of CAN protocol.
- Basic knowledge of AUTOSAR and its modules.
- Process improvement using scripting languages (Python).

Tools and technical knowledge: Lauterbach T32, Enterprise Architect, IBM DOORS, IBM ClearCase, IBM ClearQuest, ASTRee, Eclipse, CANoe, CANape, CANalyzer, INCA, DaVinci, EB Tresos, dSpace SystemDesk.

positions.title: Embedded System Developer
positions.description:
Project: Indoor parking guide with RF sensors for HardRock Guadalajara Hotel.

- Design and implementation of architecture.
- Implementation using embedded C programming for 8 and 32 bits microcontrollers (PIC and STM micros).
- Low level driver development for sensors interfacing (bare metal programming for microcontrollers).
- Responsible for maintaining clear SW version control (Git).
- Responsible for PCB design and assembly.
- Responsible for suppliers contact and negotiation.

Tools and technical knowledge: Embedded C, Eclipse, Git, SmartGit, EagleCAD, ARM M-4 Cortex, STMCubeIDE, ISIS Proteus, Visual Studio Code, Zigbee protocol (XBee wireless devices), measurement devices (oscilloscope, multimeter, etc.), SWIO debugging (ARM debugging), RF sensors, Arduino, Trello.
